title_sq: Shitet 2+1+2 me 2 ballkone tek Siri Kodra
description_sq:
Mundesi shume e mire si per investim edhe per banim ne zemer te Tiranes.
Ap ndodhet ne katin e 4,sh prane ish stacionit te trenit,ne nje pallat ekzistues.I mobiuar me shume shije,ky ap ka nje lokacion ideal me aksesin shume te shpekte qe ofron ne qender te Tiranes por edhe ne periferi nepermjet unazes se vogel dhe unazes se madhe.
Shitet edhe me kredi.
title_en: For sale 2+1+2 with 2 balconies in Siri Kodra
description_en: Very good opportunity for both investment and residence in the heart of Tirana. The apartment is located on the 4th floor, near the former train station, in an existing building. Tastefully furnished, this apartment has an ideal location with excellent access to the center of Tirana, but also to the suburbs via the small ring and the big ring. Also sold on credit.
